title: Change Default Payment method to Uber Cash on iPhone app
description: This video shows how you can change your default payment method to uber cash

asr.full_text: Hey guys, this is North World Tech again. In this video we're gonna learn how we can change the default payment method from credit card to Uber Cash. So in order to do that, tap on the Uber App and then tap on the 4 lines on the top, and then tap on the payment icon. And then tap the Personal button. Alright, now you can tap on the default payment and then tap on Ubercad. Now you can see that the default payment method has changed from MasterCard to Uber Cash. All right, so that's how you change the default payment method in Uber from credit card to Uber Cash. Thanks guys for watching. And if you have not yet subscribed to our YouTube channel please subscribe to our youtube channel because we create tech videos almost every week
